data.description:
## Observation
In tests/unit/reconciler/orchestrate/test_mode_cap_enforcement.py, test_spot_check_sampling_is_deterministic_across_runs calls _fresh_renderer() twice. That helper calls importlib.import_module("rebar.reconciler.manifest_renderer") with the same name in one Python process, so both calls return the cached module. The test then calls render_throttle twice and compares the nonempty spot_check keys. Its helper comment and assertion describe fresh module loads and per-process Python hash randomization, but the test never starts another process or changes PYTHONHASHSEED. This was found during the comment-remediation review of intangible-corruptful-numbat; the prose-only patch must leave this unlisted helper/assertion unchanged.

## Plan
Create a controlled cross-process regression check that renders the same mutation fixture under at least 2 explicit distinct PYTHONHASHSEED values, captures the selected spot-check keys, and asserts the same nonempty selection. Keep the test hermetic and preserve the existing in-process assertion as useful separate coverage if desired. Correct the helper/comment/assertion to describe what each check proves.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the same 200-mutation fixture and 2 distinct PYTHONHASHSEED values, when independent Python processes render the spot-check selection, then they return the same nonempty ordered keys.
- Given the existing in-process check, when it runs, then its comment and assertion describe only the behavior it actually observes.
- Focused mode-cap tests and make verify pass after the test change.
data.title: Make spot-check determinism test exercise distinct hash seeds
